title: Pepperoni Pizza
instructions: Stretch dough, spread tomato sauce, add mozzarella and pepperoni. Bake at 250C / 480F for 10-12 minutes until the crust is golden and cheese bubbles.

title: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Top stretched dough with tomato sauce and torn mozzarella. Bake hot 10-12 minutes, finish with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Boil spaghetti. Crisp pancetta. Whisk eggs with pecorino, toss with hot pasta off heat so the egg thickens into a sauce. Finish with black pepper.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Brown beef with onion, garlic and carrot. Add tomato and wine, simmer 45 minutes. Serve over spaghetti with parmesan.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Layer meat ragu, bechamel and pasta sheets. Top with cheese and bake 40 minutes at 190C / 375F.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Whisk yolk, anchovy, garlic, lemon and oil into a dressing. Toss with chopped romaine, croutons and shaved parmesan.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop vegetables, top with feta and olives. Dress with olive oil and oregano.

title: Cheeseburger
instructions: Grill the patty, melt cheddar on top. Build in the bun with lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.

title: Chicken Caesar Wrap
instructions: Toss chicken and romaine with dressing and parmesan, roll tightly in a tortilla.

title: French Fries
instructions: Cut potatoes into batons, fry at 160C then 190C until golden and crisp. Salt immediately.

title: Sushi Rolls
instructions: Season rice with vinegar. Spread over nori, add fillings, roll tightly and slice.

title: Ramen
instructions: Simmer broth with soy. Cook noodles, top with sliced pork, soft egg, scallion and nori.

title: Pad Thai
instructions: Stir-fry noodles with tamarind and fish sauce, add shrimp, tofu and egg. Finish with sprouts and crushed peanuts.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Saute onion, garlic, ginger and spices. Add chicken and tomato, simmer in coconut milk 25 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown beef with cumin and onion. Fill warm tortillas, top with cheese, lettuce and salsa.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Whisk batter, rest briefly. Cook ladles on a buttered griddle until bubbles form, flip and serve with syrup.

title: Caprese Salad
instructions: Layer sliced tomato and mozzarella, top with basil, olive oil, balsamic and salt.

title: Fish and Chips
instructions: Coat fish in beer batter, deep-fry until golden. Serve with thick-cut fries and mushy peas.

title: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Toast rice with onion, deglaze with wine. Add hot stock ladle by ladle, stir in mushrooms, parmesan and butter.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix dry and wet ingredients, bake at 180C / 350F for 30 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Soften onion and garlic, add tomato and stock, simmer 20 minutes. Blend smooth, stir in cream and basil.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter bread, fill with cheddar and griddle until golden and the cheese melts.

title: Steak with Fries
instructions: Sear steak in a hot pan, baste with butter, garlic and thyme. Rest, then serve with fries.

title: Falafel Plate
instructions: Blend chickpeas with herbs and spices, form balls and fry. Serve in pita with tahini sauce and salad.
